title: Census of India, 1901, vol. XVI-A, North-Western Provinces and Oudh, Imperial Tables
publisher: Census Commissioner for the North-Western Provinces and Oudh
locator: Tables I and II, printed pp. 2–3 and 6, district rows 1–36. Table II p. 5 describes the 1901 boundaries. Table VI pp. 38–40 gives religion by district and p. 37 gives the Almora footnote.
